title: Task 1: Add backend data structure to index schools by exact school name

requirements.text: In backend/main.mo, add a school storage data structure that supports exact string match lookup by school name: maintain a map keyed by school name (Text) whose value is a School record containing at minimum the School_ID (Nat). This structure must be independent of UI and must not rely on partial/normalized matching (only exact Text equality).

quotes: Implementing Task 1 now: create the data structure for storing schools.

acceptanceCriteria: A Map (or equivalent) exists in backend/main.mo keyed by school name (Text) to a School record containing at least a schoolId (Nat).
Lookup behavior is based on exact Text equality only (no trimming, case folding, fuzzy matching, or partial matches).
The code compiles and existing school- and class-related functionality continues to compile without requiring any frontend changes.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Use English for any user-facing text (e.g., Runtime.trap error strings).

Do not modify any frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Do not implement the teacher student-registration workflow yet (school creation, grade selection, class creation/linking).
Do not implement manager auto-assignment or permissions changes in this task.
Do not add or change frontend screens/forms in this task.
Do not migrate or delete existing schoolRegistry/classRegistry storage in this task (only add the new name-indexed structure).
